messages:
eva (PM): Drafting an acceptance & SLA strategy for the Optimize Toolkit (batching, caching, quantization recommendations, eval-triggered alerts). Posted a short doc: https://redwood.internal/s/optoolkit-acceptance. TL;DR: propose three launch gates — perf (latency/throughput), econ (cost/unit improvement), and quality (eval regressions). Need quick triage: which items are blockers vs nice-to-have?

liam (EngLead): Reading now. Quick thoughts: perf gate needs p95 and p99 SLOs per model class, with test harness for representative workloads. Also require a stress test job (50% above expected traffic) in Dedicated.

noah (ML): For quantization recs we should define allowable fidelity delta. Propose: synthetic eval set + production prompt sample; fail if any metric drops > 1.5% absolute or >5% relative (whichever is worse). Also need a clear rollback signal.

zoe (Ops): Ops asks: canary windows + autoscale smoke checks mandatory. We need an ops checklist: prometheus alerts, cost burn monitor, and a 'slow-start' policy. Without those, we can't greenlight Private deployments.

matt (Support): Customer asks coming from two Enterprise pilots: 1) manual canary controls, 2) audit log retention 1y for eval-triggered alerts, and 3) option to opt-out of auto-quantization. Flagging as potential commercial negotiation point.

devon (SRE): From infra angle: require a rollback fast-path that re-routes to last-good model variant in <30s. Also want a Job that verifies KV cache correctness after rollout (checksum-based). Snippet for rollout config I proposed:

```yaml
rollout_policy:
  canary_percent: 10
  canary_duration: 30m
  metric_watchlist:
    - latency_p99
    - error_rate
    - embed_cosine_degradation
  rollback_thresholds:
    latency_p99: +20%
    error_rate: +0.5%
```

eva (PM): Nice. Can we converge on numeric thresholds today? We need to publish acceptance criteria to the pilot customers by EOD Friday.

liam (EngLead): I'll own perf thresholds. Proposal: p95 <= 80ms, p99 <= 250ms for short-context models; p95 <= 180ms, p99 <= 600ms for long-context. Throughput: stable QPS at target batch sizes with <=10% tail amplification.

noah (ML): I'll finalize quantization fidelity numbers and the exact eval sets. Also add 'guardrail' that forces non-quantized path for sensitive customers.

zoe (Ops): Ops can own canary + alerting runbook. Need one more thing: who triggers the canary cutover? PM or SRE? Recommend SRE for day-0.

matt (Support): From CS: customers will want a short explainer about why eval alerts might fire and how to respond. Can we include a one-pager in the pilot kit?

eva (PM): Yes — I'll draft pilot kit (acceptance checklist + one-pager + runbook). Action items: liam: perf thresholds + stress job by Wed. noah: quant thresholds + eval sets by Wed. zoe/devon: canary + rollback runbook by Thu. matt: one-pager draft by Thu. I'll consolidate and send to pilots Fri morning. 

rollout-bot: Deployment ticket created: OPT-4219 — "Optimize Toolkit: Acceptance gates + pilot runbook" (assignee: eva).
